name: ainiee-translate
description: Agent-native novel/EPUB translation, AiNiee-style — no AiNiee app required.

plugins.name: ainiee-translate
plugins.description: Translate a novel/epub end-to-end on the coding agent (Claude Code / Codex): parse, build a locked glossary, translate chapter by chapter (names preserved, title 3-way, term consistency), optional multi-agent parallel mode, write back and export. Self-contained Python pipeline (vendored parse/export for epub/txt/docx/xlsx/… — no AiNiee repo); pip install a few light libs. AINIEE_REPO optional, only for PDF/Office.
